4. Snow Processes: Melting Prior to Snow-Ice Conversion
If snow exists, available Qm melts snow first:
• Snow melts first; remaining Q melts sea ice.
• If snow is completely melted, surplus is Qmrem.
Note: Q(s→i) < 0 denotes ice thickness gain.
5. Ice Energy Budget & Thickness Update hi
Qice = Kz(Ti - Tf) + Q(o→i) + Qmrem + Q(s→i)
+ warms/melts base; − removes heat, grows ice
• Ti < Tf : Conductive flux drives congelation growth
• Ti > Tf : Drives basal ablation / melting

• Used for correction: Qamodified = Qa - Qmax
